market.summary: Based on Upwork's 2026 in-demand skills report, art and book marketplaces, and job boards for November 2026. Websites, logos and video are where most clients are. VTuber work and book illustration are strong niches. More and more clients ask for "no AI". Each keyword opens that site's newest posts.

niches.name: Websites & landing pages
niches.why: Full-stack, web design and front-end are Upwork's most-hired coding skills in 2026. Job boards this month are full of redesigns, WordPress and online-shop builds.

x: "need a website" (business OR shop OR store)
facebook: need a website for my business

niches.name: Logos & graphic design
niches.why: Graphic design is #1 in Upwork's design category, and logo design work grew about 44% in a year. Thumbnails and flyers are steady small jobs.

facebook: need a logo for my business

niches.name: Animation, explainers & motion graphics
niches.why: Video production jumped from 7th to 4th in Upwork's creative skills. Clients want explainer videos, animated logos and YouTube animation. Some roles combine motion design with web skills.

niches.name: VTuber models, Live2D rigging & emotes
niches.why: A busy niche. Model art and rigging are often bought separately, so you can sell art without rigging. Emote packs go for about $100–250 and rigged models for $300–1,500 or more.

x: "need emotes" OR "looking for an emote artist"

niches.name: Book illustration & covers
niches.why: Self-published authors hire their own illustrators. Reedsy saw almost 4 times more cover requests asking for "no AI" in 2026 than in 2025, which works in a human artist's favour.

x: "children's book illustrator" (looking OR need OR hiring)

niches.name: Indie game art (pixel art, sprites, 2D)
niches.why: Indie studios regularly look for pixel artists, 2D animators and background artists. Many offers are small or revenue-share only, so check the pay first.

facebook: looking for pixel artist for game

niches.name: Character design & custom art
niches.why: Character sheets, OCs and D&D characters are the classic commission. Buyers pay more for clearly human-made art than for AI images.

tips: Write "100% hand-drawn, no AI" in your profile and replies. More clients are asking for it.
Websites + animation together is a strong combo: some clients want motion design and front-end in one person.
Adobe stopped selling Animate on March 1, 2026. Learning another tool, like Toon Boom, Spine, Rive or After Effects, matches what clients will ask for.
Watch out for very low budgets ($10 jobs exist) and 'revenue share only' game offers.
Jobs fixing or editing AI images and video grew fast on Upwork (+95% and +329%). That's extra work if you're open to it.
This report covers the month. For what clients posted today and this week, look at 'Trending now' below, which updates every morning.
